daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Rolling Performance with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, write a query that calculates: (1) the 20-day rolling average closing price for each stock using a window function, (2) rank stocks by their year-to-date return using RANK(), (3) identify the date each stock hit its 52-week high using ROW_NUMBER(). Filter to show only stocks in the Technology or Financials sectors. Expected output: stock_code, date, closing_price, rolling_avg_20d, ytd_rank, weeks_52_high_date.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Risk Scoring
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data and create a Python script using pandas to: (1) clean date/time columns and handle missing values in injury severity fields, (2) remove duplicate crash records based on crash ID and timestamp, (3) engineer a 'risk_score' feature combining speed limit, number of vehicles, and injury count, (4) aggregate crashes by local government area (LGA) and export a CSV ranking LGAs by total crashes and average risk_score. Expected output: cleaned dataset and LGA summary CSV with columns: lga_name, total_crashes, avg_risk_score, injury_count.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production Pipeline: SQL + Python ETL
daily_quests.description: Create an end-to-end data pipeline: (1) In Python, fetch or load Australian wine production statistics data (by region and vintage year), clean it (handle missing production volumes, standardise region names), and load into a SQLite database. (2) In SQL, write a query using CTEs to: calculate year-over-year production growth by region, identify top 3 regions by volume in the latest year, and rank vintages by total national production. (3) In Python, execute the SQL query and create a summary report (CSV or JSON) showing region rankings, growth trends, and anomalies. Expected deliverables: SQLite database schema, SQL query with CTEs, and final summary report.
